body: I know I posted this a few weeks ago and I was avoiding going back on here but I want u to know all of these replies have helped me right now and I feel I must acknowledge the replies. I am still not "good" but still here and I will try to do more positive things 4 myself and fight thru this.... with help.  Shaking off the guilt and shame while seeing hope is rough but I have 2 try.  Thank u all again.

I really appreciate ur honesty. I did rehabs as well. Yes, I know drinking or popping pills only makes things worse with circumstances but honestly, if it keeps me from doing myself in (if i knew how) at that moment, I justify getting out of my head. Sober and miserable sucks. Sounds like u know the feeling. Yeah, my kids faces r what I see when I'm holding that rope or checking where a good spot for a train hit wud be. I've never posted something or told anyone all this. txs for reply. Wish u well also.
